contract: A road user's heading is changing at the observation: the absolute value of its yaw rate exceeds yaw_floor. Yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is in deg/s, left positive, and either hand counts; yaw_floor is the source's yaw-rate resolution. Not denoted: a turn at a junction, a lane change, or the curvature of the road: a road user yaws wherever its path bends, and one running straight does not.

params.name: yaw_floor
params.meaning: the source's yaw-rate resolution: an absolute yaw rate at or below it counts as no heading change

elements.span: the absolute value of its yaw rate exceeds yaw_floor
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate is the 'rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left'; it is 'Not a stand-in for: road curvature', and the concept reads the body's own heading change, not the road's shape.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A car swings its heading while backing around a curb, its yaw rate well above the floor.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A car drives along a straight lane with zero yaw rate.
